how.label: How it works
how.title: Simple for everyone
how.subtitle: Whether you need care or provide it — the process is fast and secure.

1.title: Create your profile
1.desc: Sign up in minutes. Add patient information, history and care needs.

2.title: Find professionals
2.desc: See nurses and caregivers available in your area with ratings and specialties.

3.title: Book the service
3.desc: Choose time, duration and type of service. From 1h to 24h shifts or weekly recurring.

4.title: Track everything
4.desc: Receive post-service reports, rate the professional and pay securely.

1.title: Submit your documents
1.desc: Active COREN, diploma, criminal record check and live selfie. Approval within 48h.

2.title: Set your schedule
2.desc: Define your available days, hours and service radius. You control when you work.

3.title: Accept requests
3.desc: Get notifications for nearby requests. Accept or decline with one tap. No pressure.

4.title: Get paid
4.desc: Automatic payment after each service. Straight to your account via PIX, no delays.
